content.value: Consider slab of thickness L. The boundary ‘surface at x=0 and x=L are maintained at constant but different temperature $\mathbf { T } _ { 1 }$ and ${ \sf T } _ { 2 }$ respectively. There is no energy generation in the solid and the thermal conductivity k is constant. Develop an expression for the temperature distribution $\mathrm { T } _ { ( \mathbf { x } ) }$ in the slab and the thermal resistance of the slab for the heat flow through an area A.
